game_title: Stack Of Plates – Whisper Stones Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones, standing whisper stones: the scholar mage must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Whisper Stones: standing whisper stones
core_gameplay_loop: In Whisper Stones, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about stack_balance to power up the scholar mage and open the crypt seal.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 1 (intro tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
